# Two-layer IR separation (identity placement)

Fact envelopes do not include a slug (identity-free), whereas Entity envelopes include a slug field; identity is carried in Entity, not Fact.

Separate per-compile, disposable fact data from durable, slug-bearing knowledge entities.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/ir.py` — `knowledge_compiler.ir.Fact`
- `knowledge_compiler/ir.py` — `knowledge_compiler.ir.Entity`
